name: view_duel_bottle_candidates
description: A rival's corked bottle names its candidates, never which one (M8, design 1.4, contract-m8 §4), on the real preset over the wire (tests/net/loopback_main.gd's window and a headless partner, one seat a side). When the partner corks in window 2, both games' records give its bottle the same candidates, the packs the window offered at tier I in CHECK_IDS order, and no pack; my tray shows them under the rival's bottle as small pack icons beside its tier; its tooltip says 'Tier I, corked for wave 2. It holds one of: ... Which one stays hidden until it is uncorked.' with each pack's count at its tier; the duel bar's rival row ends 'corked I: ...' by check, through the wave the bottle is corked for. During the duel's wave the horn's tooltip says 'Waves do not stack in a duel.'. Once the partner uncorks, the candidates go and the pack shows.

steps.assert: not mine_says.has('pack') and not theirs_says.has('pack') and mine_says['candidates'] == theirs_says['candidates']
steps.msg: both games give the bottle the same candidates, and neither a pack

steps.assert: mine_says['candidates'] == ['swarm', 'swift', 'armored'] and offer.size() == 3 and offer.has('swarm') and offer.has('swift') and offer.has('armored')
steps.msg: the window's three offered packs at its tier, in CHECK_IDS order
the tray shows them under the rival's bottle, beside its tier
as the packs' own icons, small and dim

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[0] == "Your rival's bottle" and node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1] == 'Tier I, corked for wave 2. It holds one of: 6 Gourdlings (Gourd Rush), 8 Scuttlers (Scuttle) or 3 Thornbacks (Thorn Herd). Which one stays hidden until it is uncorked.'
steps.msg: its tooltip names each candidate with its count at the tier, never which

steps.assert: bar[1].begins_with('Rival · ') and bar[1].ends_with(' · corked I: Swarm, Swift or Armored') and not bar[0].contains('corked')
steps.msg: the duel bar's rival row ends with the candidates by check

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').lines()[1].ends_with(' · corked I: Swarm, Swift or Armored')
steps.msg: through the wave it is corked for

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipBody').text == 'Waves do not stack in a duel.'
steps.msg: in the duel's wave the horn says no call can stack

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(2)[0]['pack'] == offer[1] and not Game.bottles_of(2)[0].has('candidates') and node('DriftTray').rivals_shown().is_empty() and not node('DuelBar').lines()[1].contains('corked')
steps.msg: uncorked, the candidates go and the pack shows
